notes: Architecture-controlled paths for Architecture v1.1. Changes to these locations are protected: they require an Architecture Change Request (governance/acr/) and must not be carried silently by an implementation PR. The check-protected command fails the build when a changed file matches a pattern below unless the change is explicitly routed through an APPROVED ACR that enumerates the exact path (check-protected --acr, and the PR's ACR-Routing line; the routing mechanism is owned by ARCH-WF-002). Patterns marked additions=allowed are registry trees whose new-file registrations are the normal flow; modifications and deletions of existing files remain protected. This manifest is itself architecture-controlled.
